proof_body:
by
  intro γ w hγ hw
  let γ' : C(unitInterval, {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0}) := ⟨fun t => ⟨γ t, hγ t⟩, by
    exact Continuous.subtype_mk γ.continuous _⟩
  obtain ⟨Γ, h1, h2⟩ := Complex.isCoveringMap_exp.exists_path_lifts γ' w (by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hw.symm)
  have hl : ∀ t, Complex.exp (Γ t) = γ t := fun t => by
    have := congrFun h1 t
    exact congrArg Subtype.val this
  refine ⟨Γ, h2, hl, fun hc => ?_⟩
  have he : Complex.exp (Γ 1) = Complex.exp (Γ 0) := by rw [hl, hl, hc]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp he
  exact ⟨n, by rw [hn]; ring⟩
target_source: ∀ (γ : C(unitInterval, ℂ)) (w : ℂ), (∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) → Complex.exp w = γ 0 → ∃ Γ : C(unitInterval, ℂ), Γ 0 = w ∧ (∀ t, Complex.exp (Γ t) = γ t) ∧ (γ 1 = γ 0 → ∃ k : ℤ, Γ 1 - Γ 0 = k * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I))
